highlights: It is ideal for blasting dirt and grime from cars, trucks, boats, bikes, motorcycles, RVs, ATVs, and trailers. A must have for all off-road riders at the track and home being cordless it does not need power, or on hand running water, carry your own water and use their handy collapsible water bucket, allowing you to wash your motorcycle, 4×4, or offroad race car at the race venue in your own outdoor pit.
Usage: Car wash, bike cleaning, outdoor cleaning
